title: ApprovalRequestedData
description: data of approval.requested (PRD 9.5). A proposed side effect waits at a gate for a person. outbox_id is reserved for the outbox entry the gate releases, and item pins the draft or file the gate holds to its version (null when there is none); the entry's item and the gate card's gate.action.item equal it (card rule CR-12, outbox rule OB-05). Nothing is written to the outbox before the gate opens, and this event never authorises (authz null): only an approval.resolved answering approve on the same gate does (OB-01). It also records who besides the world's owner may answer (PRD 10.1), set by the harness from the owner's own records, never by a model: approver is the Approver the owner assigned this gate to (null when none), and team_lead names the expert domain whose Team Lead may answer and the owner's policy that allows it (null when no Team Lead may). Anyone else, a Viewer included, opens nothing (OB-01).

team_lead_allowance.description: A Team Lead may answer this gate: one whose owner-assigned domain (team_lead.schema.json) is domain, while policy_id names the owner's policy for this action type that lists domain in team_lead_domains (PRD 10.1: 'in their domain, if the policy allows'; OB-01).
